Grade 12 Mathematics · 2027

Grade 12 Weekly

A Maths teacher who knows your child's name, every Thursday, until the final exam.

Every Thursday evening, your Grade 12 learner joins a live, two-hour Mathematics class online, in a group of no more than 10. From February until the NSC exam, the work follows the Grade 12 CAPS syllabus, with the heaviest-weighted exam topics getting the most time.

Who it is for: Grade 12 learners at school who are aiming for a pass or a university-entry mark.

01 · What your child gets

Small groups, a fixed plan, feedback on every homework.

  • A live two-hour class every Thursday, with the recording shared afterwards
  • Paper 1 and Paper 2 content, sequenced by DBE mark weighting
  • Past-paper questions cited by year and paper, so your child sees the real exam format
  • Marked homework with voice-note feedback within 48 hours
  • A one-page parent report on the last Friday of each month
Every session follows the same four parts
  1. Key concepts checklist. What your child needs to know, on one page.
  2. Worked anchor question. A past-paper question, solved step by step.
  3. Guided live practice. Your child works while the tutor watches and steps in.
  4. Homework pack. Submitted on WhatsApp, with voice-note feedback within 48 hours.

Questions parents ask

About Grade 12 Weekly

Which topics are covered?

The full Grade 12 CAPS Mathematics syllabus. Topics are sequenced by DBE mark weighting, so the sections worth the most marks are taught first and revised most.

What if my child misses a session?

The recording and the homework pack are shared with them. We don't refund missed sessions.

When does the programme end?

Thursday classes run until the NSC exam. We confirm the last date once the DBE publishes the 2027 NSC timetable.

Is there extra exam help?

Yes. The Exam Bootcamp runs in the June and September/October school holidays, and Grade 12 learners can join it.

More questions? See the full FAQ or ask us on WhatsApp.
